title: Russian FPV Drone Strikes Car in Sumy Oblast, Killing 4 Civilians
detail: A Russian FPV drone struck a car in Shostka district, Sumy Oblast — about 44 km from the Russian border — on September 19, killing all four civilians inside: a married couple (58-year-old man and 56-year-old woman), a 45-year-old man, and a 76-year-old woman. Regional Governor Oleh Hryhorov reported the attack. Russian troops struck 18 settlements in Sumy Oblast 47 times over the day, with the FPV strike accounting for all four fatalities region-wide.

title: Russian Drone Strikes Kherson Monastery, Killing Monk, Injuring Four
detail: A Russian drone struck the St. Gregory Bizyukivsky Monastery in Beryslav district, Kherson Oblast, around 15:00 on September 19, killing a 71-year-old monk (known as monk Moisei, the monastery's oldest resident) and injuring four other monks aged 51, 53, 51, and 31 with blast and mine-related injuries. Monastery buildings were damaged. Head of the Kherson Regional Military Administration Oleksandr Prokudin said Russian troops attacked 43 settlements across the region over the prior 24 hours, killing 3 people (including the monk) and wounding 9, including a child; damage included a high-rise building, 16 private homes, a gas station, a farm building and a gas pipeline.

media.caption: St. Gregory Bizyukivsky Monastery in Beryslav district, Kherson Oblast, damaged by a Russian drone strike that killed a monk, September 19, 2026

title: 'Irreparable Tragedy' — Mother and Two Children Killed in Russian Drone Strike on Kyiv Oblast
detail: A Russian drone struck a residential house in the village of Hlevakha, Fastiv district, Kyiv Oblast, at 22:37 on September 19, killing a 39-year-old woman and two young children — a 2-year-old boy and a 3-year-old girl — and injuring another woman. Kyiv Regional Military Administration head Tymur Tkachenko called it 'an irreparable tragedy,' saying 'there are no words to express the pain of this loss.' Air raid alerts continued almost uninterrupted through the day as Russian forces repeatedly struck the region with drones, damaging at least 31 sites across five districts, with Fastiv district hit hardest (24 sites, including homes, industrial and utility buildings, and vehicles).

media.caption: Aftermath of the Russian drone strike on a house in Hlevakha, Fastiv district, Kyiv Oblast, that killed a mother and two children, September 19, 2026
